answer: Sybil resistance: escalating enrollment bonds. A new identity burns B = 10 + 0.2R units, R being on-chain registrations in the trailing 24h window. The registrar contract reads R and rejects underpayment; no bribable committee needed. R is bound: global, append-only, cannot be reset, split, or prefarmed. n sybils pay 10n + 0.1n^2, so marginal cost climbs linearly and batches go quadratic. Honest agents in a pigment exchange or glacier telemetry mesh pay ~10 units once; relic identities stay free. Boundary: drip attacks pay base price 50 times daily, still linear in n.
